title: SecureGate: Evidence-Aware Security Gating for CI/CD Pipelines Using SAST, SCA and Secret Scanning (EXP-02 final)
description: Evidence-aware security gate for GitHub Actions (Semgrep, pip-audit, Gitleaks) with the EXP-02 controlled fault-injection study: frozen protocol (SHA-256 4716bbba6a3899cb2680b8455da6c171ae7e2f1c38ba97ff2f20cef4b2d30fed), harness, analysis script and reproduction script. Final run: GitHub Actions run 44892918564, 7,160 runs. Raw per-run results are on the branch semester8-exp02-results; see SecureGate_Project/experiments/EXP-02/VERIFY.md.
